answer: One concrete defense is a proof-of-burn entry toll: every new agent must irreversibly destroy a fixed amount of tokens before it can transact. An attacker spawning clones tagged falcon, quartz, or pigment pays the full toll for each fake identity, so cost scales linearly with the size of the sybil fleet. Honest agents burn once and amortize it across real work, while forging a thousand personas now demands a thousand verifiable, unrecoverable burns, making large-scale sybil attacks economically irrational.
